set_language: Warm candlelit 17th-century world: dark oak, cream linen, brass, leather books, London fog. Body cutaways are clean, glowing illustrations (warm red arteries, cool blue veins), never anatomical gore. Say 'same 1616 London lecture room' or 'same Harvey study' for continuity; never 'same DNA'.
explorer_lock: ONE beat (plate 08): in Harvey's study the Explorer sets out a tiny jug for every heartbeat; the jugs fill the desk, spill onto the floor and march out of the door; he turns wide-eyed to the single loaf. Attach the Explorer reference.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; gore, wounds, blood on skin, cut flesh or real animal organs (animal hearts only as Harvey's ink drawings); live or dead animals on a table; lava drip / molten bead; underside lamp bulb or shade cup; unfinished flat cards; garbled writing; unfinished Explorer hair; DNA helix; readable text or logos baked into the plate (labels and the De Motu Cordis title are added in the edit); twin Explorer; faces in the first two seconds of the film; a flame, lantern or lamp in frame on a Fast plate. Never say 'same DNA' or 'lab DNA' in a Veo prompt.
always_fails: garbled card text or wrong sums (2 oz, 1/8, 1000 checked by hand)
unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
gore: wound, blood on skin, cut flesh, real animal organs
a face in the first two seconds of the film
a flame, lantern or lamp in frame on a Fast plate (remint on Quality or reframe)
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns.
quality_note: Flow Veo 3.1 on the Mac Mini CDP worker, benoats@googlemail.com only. Quality only where the hero is an emissive or fragile light (flame in frame, glowing cutaway or loop, stove heart, lanterns); Fast where candlelight is room ambience and no flame, lantern or lamp is in frame. Reason per plate in engine_reason. A Fast take with a flame or lamp in frame fails: reframe or remint on Quality. One plate at a time until the first KEEP; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
labels: White Didot italic side label, 1-4 words, one at a time, on the plate's first beat (or at the stated offset); added in the edit. Never two at once.

plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Point of view from a hard back bench of the same 1616 London lecture room, cold and candlelit, oak panels: breath mists in the cold, candle flames shiver in the foreground; at the front William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, moves his pointer across a huge painted heart chart. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
vo_land: Picture yourself in his lecture room in London.
It's cold, the candles are lit, and you're on a hard wooden bench.

plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Harvey's notebook on his desk: brown-ink drawings of the slow hearts of a frog and an eel with little sketch arrows; pages turn gently, and on the last page the ink drawing of the heart slowly squeezes and relaxes on the paper. Ink drawings only, no live animal, no readable text. Warm candlelight falls from out of frame; no candle, flame, lantern or lamp in shot. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
vo_land: Harvey has spent years watching the slow hearts of cold-blooded animals, like frogs and eels, where each beat is easy to see.

vo_land: (continues) Harvey has spent years watching the slow hearts of cold-blooded animals, like frogs and eels, where each beat is easy to see.
And what he saw was simple.
The heart isn't a stove.
It's a muscle, and it squeezes.

vo_land: Each squeeze pushes blood out into the arteries, and that push is the pulse you feel in your wrist.

plates.side_label: THE SAME BLOOD → IT CIRCULATES (+6.5 s)
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway: the same red stream leaves the heart through the arteries and comes back to it through blue veins, round and round; the camera pulls back to see the whole glowing loop on a simple body outline as the stream runs steadily round. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
vo_land: The heart pumps it out through the arteries, and it comes back through the veins, round and round.
It circulates.

plates.engine_reason: Quality: the glowing cutaway, stream or loop is the hero (emissive light).
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same glowing loop with a brass clock hand sweeping once round the circle as a single glowing drop completes one lap. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
vo_land: (continues) It circulates.
We now know he was being very careful: your heart pumps all of your blood round your body in about a minute.
